sanskrit_verse:
अन्तरा जन्ममरणे शेषाहोभिर् विशुद्ध्यति ।
गर्भस्रावे मासतुल्याः निशाः शुद्धेस् तु कारणम् ॥३.२०॥
transliteration: antarā janmamaraṇe śeṣāhobhir viśudhyati | garbhasrāve māsatulyāḥ niśāḥ śuddheḥ tu kāraṇam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Between birth and death, the remaining nights purify through natural completion; in case of miscarriage, nights equivalent to a month are the cause of purification.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from the sequential unfolding of conscious existence.
Causation aligns with the rhythm of embodied life and its natural terminus.
Capacity-based responsibility arises only upon viable manifestation of intent.
Restoration logic operates through temporal alignment with cosmic rhythm.
Consciousness alignment is restored through completion cycles, not punitive interruption.
executable_legal_axioms: IF gestational termination occurs BEFORE viability THEN no juridical consequence attaches.
IF post-natal life commences THEN residual purification time equals remainder nights till full term.
IF miscarriage occurs THEN assign thirty nights as default purification duration.
ALL adjudications MUST defer to biological rhythm as primary evidence of dharma-aligned process.
NO punitive measure shall interrupt or accelerate purification timelines.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that legal thresholds of personhood commence at viable birth, not conception. Responsibility is capacity-bound and temporally sequenced. Purification periods are constitutionally mandated restorative intervals, overriding punitive frameworks.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is derived from the observable cycle of gestation and birth. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential unfolding of consciousness through embodiment. Proportional responsibility corresponds to actualized capacity. The non-punitive reality rule affirms purification as inherent to temporal order, not judicial imposition.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Assign prescribed night-count for natural purification.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Recognize biological rhythm as determinant of lawful action.
Capacity Restoration: Confirm absence of viable intent pre-birth.
Integrity Reintegration: Acknowledge completion cycle as sufficient for consciousness realignment.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This law restores purity through temporal alignment. Justice serves reintegration, not punishment. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth. Reality remains ever non-punitive.
